sections.chapter_title: Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)
sections.text_helper: Section 27.7.9 "DMA features" in chapter 27 (Serial peripheral interface / integrated interchip sound (SPI/I2S)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 875.
sections.section_content:
In I2S mode, the DMA works in exactly the same way as it does in SPI mode. There is no
difference except that the CRC feature is not available in I2S mode since there is no data
transfer protection system.
